method: Independent, evidence-only Cursor CLI synthesis. The model received only this entity's saved evidence package.

sentiment.summary: Ethereum coverage in this 30-day window was largely constructive: Fidelity filed with the SEC to add staking to its Ether ETF, Goldman Sachs’s planned NEOS acquisition would include Ether-linked income funds, and the Ethereum Foundation funded WEBCAT under its Trillion Dollar Security program and added a long-time contributor to its board. CoinDesk also reported Russia would limit retail crypto trading to bitcoin, ether and USDT, with a purchase cap for non-qualified investors. This is ecosystem and news sentiment, not investment advice.

tags.label: institutional ETF products
tags.why: Fidelity filed with the SEC to add staking to its Ethereum ETF (85% of rewards retained by FETH with quarterly cash distributions), and Goldman Sachs’s planned $2.25B NEOS acquisition would add Ether-linked income funds.

tags.label: retail trading limits
tags.why: Russia moved to restrict retail crypto trading to bitcoin, ether and USDT, with a 300,000-ruble (about $3,600) annual purchase limit per intermediary for non-qualified investors and no cap for qualified investors.

tags.label: ecosystem security grant
tags.why: The Ethereum Foundation’s Trillion Dollar Security initiative allocated a grant to Freedom of the Press Foundation to continue developing WEBCAT, an open-source tool for browsers to verify that served website code matches what developers published.

tags.label: foundation governance
tags.why: The Ethereum Foundation announced that pcaversaccio, a long-time ecosystem contributor, SEAL 911 co-founder, and Silviculture Society member, joined the Foundation Board.

sentiment.coverage_note: Five usable items from three independent sources with status ok (Cointelegraph, CoinDesk, Ethereum Foundation). Reddit returned auth-failed; grounding and YouTube returned no-results.
